value.desc: You don't choose to size people up. The read finishes before you've decided to start it, and it's usually right.
The edge everyone sees is covering a depth of care that almost no one earns access to. The few who do never doubt it again.
People come to you when they've had enough comfort. You tell them what's real, plainly, and they leave knowing where they stand.
When everyone else shifts to keep the peace, you don't. People depend on that more than they ever say.
When everything is falling apart, you get sharper. What others force out with effort, you produce in surplus under pressure.
Your read takes longer to close, and that's its strength. When you finally call something finished, it stays finished.
